name: Aria Resort & Casino
positioning: ARIA Resort & Casino, a large Las Vegas casino resort with floor-to-ceiling-window rooms, Sky Suites, a spa, pools with cabanas and a casino floor with fresh-air ventilation
best_for: Travelers who want a Las Vegas casino resort with a spa and pools
Guests looking for suites with floor-to-ceiling skyline views

facts.text: Deluxe King and Deluxe Two Queen rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and state-of-the-art technology.
The Corner Tower Suite with Strip view has floor-to-ceiling skyline views.
ARIA's Sky Suites include a One Bedroom Penthouse with panoramic views, about 1,345 square feet.
The Spa at ARIA has an extensive menu of treatments, alongside a salon.
Wellness at ARIA offers a wide range of fitness and wellness programs.
ARIA's casino floor has a fresh air ventilation system.
Carbone, from Mario Carbone, Rich Torrisi and Jeff Zalaznick, pays homage to mid-20th-century Italian-American restaurants with tableside service.
MGM Rewards members earn rewards for hotel stays, dining and gaming.

highlights.text: The Sky Suites One Bedroom Penthouse has panoramic views across about 1,345 square feet.
The Corner Tower Suite looks over the Strip through floor-to-ceiling windows.
The Spa at ARIA offers an extensive treatment menu, plus a salon.
The casino floor uses a fresh air ventilation system.
Bardot Brasserie serves classic French cuisine from Chef Michael Mina.

considerations.text: ARIA is a full casino resort, with slots, table games, poker and JEWEL Nightclub on site.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes the resort's large size can mean longer walks between amenities.
